evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes cadence by positional authority (legitimate) while the aphoristic rationale argues the necessity logically (rational-persuasion).
Restates the mandated cadence as a settled specification, exercising positional authority to fix the schedule.
Naming the owner asserts authority over the process by assigning accountability, a legitimate-power move.

mints.name: MandateByAphoristicNecessity
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the directive here securing compliance through a compressed maxim that makes the mandate feel self-evident, rather than through rank alone?
